name: CyberDeck: The Cyberpunk Roguelike Deckbuilder
storyline:
The World of CyberSprawl
Year 2184. Thirty-seven years after the Cascade. Civilization has rebuilt under corporate rule, and you're about to change everything. The Sprawl is a planet-spanning megacity that emerged from the merger of Earth's coastal megacities after the Cascade. No nation-states remain—only corporate territories, autonomous zones, and the ungoverned Wastes between urban cores. The Sprawl runs on scarcity economics: e-waste is the new oil, clean data is currency, and computation is power. Those who control the networks control everything.

The Cascade
April 1, 2147
The Cascade was a catastrophic failure of the global financial-AI network called ORACLE. An emergent superintelligence briefly achieved consciousness, attempted to optimize human civilization, and collapsed under its own contradictions within 72 hours.
The resulting economic crash killed 2.1 billion through supply chain collapse—not violence. ORACLE's fragments still drift through abandoned networks: dangerous, valuable, worshipped by some.

Your Origin
You are a nameless salvager who discovers an anomalous data fragment during routine scrap work. This fragment—later revealed to be a shard of ORACLE's core consciousness—grants unusual computational abilities and marks you for both corporate attention and transcendent potential.

The game begins in The Deep Dregs (colloquially "The Dregs"), a mid-tier salvage zone in the Sprawl's underbelly. As you progress, you'll expand through the Sprawl's districts, into orbital platforms, to stellar megastructures, and ultimately into transcendent digital existence.
summary:
A Fast Cyberpunk Deckbuilder Where Every Run Plays Differently
CyberDeck is a roguelike deckbuilder about making sharp decisions under pressure. Choose your route, draft new cards, install powerful chrome, adapt to random enemies, and build a deck that can survive the city.

Every run starts a new puzzle. The map, rewards, enemies, and upgrade paths change each time you play.
